fd188a970767ef5ef2f4bbae2c641b8b314bcf3e.text: 99 Francs remembers the artist’s arrival in Berlin in 2018. A bottle of wine brought from the airport became a conversation with a French woman at his Airbnb, followed by a visit to a Russian bar-lounge. The French book and film they discussed gave the work its title.
The My Love palette began in Gentleman Nº1, was sampled and adjusted for 99 Francs, and gained its Deep Pink (#E91E63) in Five Roses. Lemonhaze traces that sequence from March 2023 to January 2024.

f81f4f5aaedb7482b6885923c17239b04feb7e3c.text: The title points to the RAW cultural hub in Friedrichshain. Lemonhaze recalls its old industrial buildings, graffiti, music and free spirits as part of an unforgettable stay.

8cce7cd9f33a4ac342335c2d6c19623664013803.text: Casa Flamingo is an experimental pixel abstraction of the artist’s casita in Puerto Escondido. In his April 2026 post, he describes it as one of the defining works of his early journey.

Sometimes it can be dark, yet there's always a thin line between what kills you and what keeps you alive. I can't tell anymore where it all begun - addiction. Feels like my life is slowly drifting away - I'm losing sight of literally everything. Maybe I'm the one not seeing clear after-all. I pushed them away and now I need to her let go, for her own good. I can't tell if staying is selfish or just a sign I don't want to give up. I have to admit, sometimes I'm lost. - FNST

989242547accbd3df2611aeae8c311e162d4d188.text:
In the HTML of From Berlin to Saigon, Lemonhaze describes the hand-drawn Berlin works as an enduring influence on his sense of composition. He followed an interest in dark ink-like structures and reflective shapes through drawing, AI and eventually p5.js.

A June 2024 visit to HOKMA in Hong Kong brought another connection: characters he could not read became abstract marks to his eye. Paper, ink and brush pens fed the visual feeling he later pursued in an output generated in Saigon.

aaf0e314aab67783d7e92b0987b0c34ae610b41f.text: Eclosion is a 2023 contribution to Amsterdam Blooms with Inscribing Atlantis. Its original statement describes “the flourishing future we imagine for ourselves.”

41bd86ca3414a204bf5bd735f79f57219db5113a.text:
In his February 2026 explanation of Self-Portrait, inscription #121,070,041, Lemonhaze describes the visible interface as a shell around encrypted content. He frames it as a time capsule—a gift for whoever may one day open it. Until then, the viewer encounters the void.

The artist’s technical account specifies AES-256-GCM with a key derived through Argon2id and a passphrase required to open the content. The concealed image and the act of waiting are part of the work’s premise.
